title: Apeiron: Blotter Server
description: antikythera (blotter server) and hermes (mock middleware). Red lines are the POC targets.

panels.title: Clients
panels.description: Open WebSocket connections.

panels.title: Store rows
panels.description: Rows in the columnar store.

panels.title: Server RSS
panels.description: Target: under 2 GB with 50 clients.

panels.title: Hermes preset
panels.description: The load preset hermes is running.

panels.title: LIVE orders
panels.description: Orders currently LIVE in hermes.

panels.title: Price ticks/s
panels.description: Price ticks hermes publishes per second.

panels.title: Order events/s
panels.description: Order events hermes publishes per second.

panels.title: Slow-consumer closes
panels.description: Clients closed with SLOW_CONSUMER in the last hour.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Process CPU as a share of one core (Node is single-threaded, so 1.0 means the event loop is saturated).

panels.title: RSS and heap
panels.description: antikythera memory. Red line: 2 GB RSS target.

panels.title: Event-loop lag p50 / p99
panels.description: Lag above the 10 ms sampling resolution, over each one-second window. Red line: p99 target 50 ms.

panels.title: GC pause rate
panels.description: Share of time spent in garbage collection.

panels.title: WS clients
panels.description: Connections, and clients that said hello by codec.

panels.title: Flush duration p50 / p99
panels.description: One flush tick: apply events and prices, patch the cached views, build every client's delta (100 ms tick).

panels.title: getRows latency, warm
panels.description: Server-side time to serve a block from a cached view. Red line: p95 target 50 ms.

panels.title: getRows latency, cold
panels.description: Server-side time for a request that has to build its view (a sort, filter or group change). Red line: 300 ms target.

panels.title: Delta latency: event age at flush
panels.description: Age of the oldest queued order event or price tick when its flush runs: the server-side share of tick-to-screen. Measured from hermes's publish timestamp. Red line: p95 target 150 ms.

panels.title: Delta size p50 / p95
panels.description: Encoded size of one delta message.

panels.title: Command latency
panels.description: Command round trip from request to ack or error, by outcome (ok or the error code). Target: status change within 500 ms. Red line: 500 ms target.

panels.title: Ingest rate
panels.description: Events ingested by antikythera per second: price ticks, order events, client commands.

panels.title: Write-behind
panels.description: Orders waiting to be persisted, and the batch size of each Mongo upsert.

panels.title: Write-behind latency
panels.description: Mongo upsert time per batch.

panels.title: View cache size
panels.description: Views held, and the index memory they use (bytes, right axis in the legend).

panels.title: Backpressure events
panels.description: soft_conflate: a delta was held back for a client over the soft cap. slow_consumer: a client was closed.

panels.title: LIVE orders and preset
panels.description: LIVE and pending orders; the dashed-in step shows when the stress preset is active.
